F1_s1.explanation: The unit responds to a compact, roughly symmetric patch of fine, high-contrast detail sitting at the center of a larger, smoother region of fairly uniform color or texture, especially when thin elongated shapes radiate or stick out from that patch. Weaker responses come from small detailed marks or insignia placed on large flat colored panels.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to a compact, roughly symmetric patch of fine, high-contrast detail sitting at the center of a larger, smoother region of fairly uniform color or texture, especially when thin elongated shapes radiate or stick out from that patch. Weaker responses come from small detailed marks or insignia placed on large flat colored panels.
parsed.evidence: The strongest boxes (8-10) land on small textured focal blobs, often with paired or radiating thin protrusions, set against even surroundings. Lower-ranked boxes (7-8) land on small detailed marks on broad flat painted surfaces, and random images lacking such a focal patch mostly score 1-2.
parsed.missing_data: Synthetic tests that separate a centered detailed patch, radiating thin protrusions, and a flat surround, plus per-pixel activation maps, would show which ingredient drives the response and whether the two groups truly share one pattern.
